notes: Greek/Hebrew transliteration is checked by shared_validation/text_checks.py::check_greek_hebrew_transliteration (already wired into validate_encounters.py / validate_discovery.py), not by this file.

The vocative particle يا must always be a separate word from the noun/name it introduces (يَا رَبُّ, not يَارَبُّ). Found fused across 8 pre-existing AR files (2026-07-26) and fixed; even inconsistent within single files before the fix. forbidden_patterns above catches the specific fused forms found so far — extend this list if a new fused يا+noun combination appears in future translations.
